body: There are so many things I love about this pillow. First of all, it arrived timely & well packaged. I immediately removed the pillow case and washed it so I could start using the pillow immediately. I've had neck & back issues for years, I rarely get a good night's rest. I have tried all sorts of pillows hoping one of them would make a difference. I decided to give this one a shot. I usually sleep on my side or stomach. I never sleep on my back bc it's usually so uncomfortable. Even if I end up on my back in the middle of the night, it wakes me up... So the first thing I noticed with this pillow that greatly surprised me was that I was actually able to lay on my back without any issues. I wasn't even expecting to be able to do that... I'm not sure how or why It helps so much, but it does! Sleeping on my side and stomach are just as comfortable. I love that when you sleep on your stomach, it has places to put your arms. Usually they end up under the pillow which ends up being uncomfortable after awhile. But that completely resolves that issue. One other thing that I didn't expect to be such a positive aspect was being able to use the pillow when I sit upright. Usually before I go to bed I will watch some tv or read. So I will strategically arrange my pillows so I can sit upright. I put this new pillow behind me (as you can see in the picture) & it is awesome! It's so comfortable that it helps me decompress & relax easier than my old way. I would buy it just for that alone! This is probably the longest review I have ever written. I know how helpful it has been to me, so if anyone else has same issues or is on the fence...I hope this helps. I honestly can't say enough about this pillow. I definitely recommend it!!!

body: It took over a week to use this properly as I had to look at a you tube especially for side sleeping. Much better now that I know how to use this pillow. I do get a neck pain the next day upon awakening on some days but that seems to be subsiding. Hope this helps. Can't give it 5 stars yet.

author: Erica Butler
title: Cool, comfortable, and no more waking up with neck pain
body: This pillow is amazing for sleep! I've used it for over a month and have the best sleep with it. It is very comfortable, the design is great, my neck no longer hurts when I wake up, it keeps my head cool and you can use it for side sleeping as well! This is a must buy if you want a great night of sleep!

author: Jason Medina
title: Great sleep even after long days on the road
body: I am in love with this pillow 😍 As a truck driver who drives for 11 hours a day, I need my sleep, and the pillow is a vital factor into getting quality sleep. With this pillow, I've been able to sleep quite comfortably in any position! I'm usually a someone who sleeps on their side but with this pillow I can actually sleep on my back and stomach with was pleasantly surprising. I especially love how it keeps it's shape and stays cool, I use to wake up with my neck hurting because my other normal shaped pillows would get flat where my head would lay. Haven't had that issue since I bought this pillow 2 months ago! 10/10 would recommend to anyone trying to use a cooler pillow, who's not wanting to wake up with a sore neck, who wants to get quality sleep, and if you have a pretty hectic life style like OTR drivers!

author: Quinn A.
title: Even as a stomach sleeper, I'm finally resting well
body: I've always struggled to find the right pillow because I am a stomach sleeper. This pillow is by far the BEST ever. I now have a restful night. Thank you for an amazing product!

author: Jordan
title: It fits my long neck, and my husband likes it too
body: This pillow was given to me by my mom. I've a long neck. This pillow alignment is right for me and my husband use the same pillow. Very commfy.

author: Kendall M.
title: Firm and soft at the same time—I'm impressed
body: I've had a few orthopedic pillows , I've one I really like for awhile now , decided to try this one and so far I really like it , it shipped quickly and is firm but soft at the same time , it's a winner great pillow .

author: sydney102
title: Comfortable support, especially for back and side sleepers
body: This pillow cradles you. It’s comfortable. I use it and do not have pain in my neck. It’s not particularly a pillow you would use if you sleep on your stomach. Mostly a pillow for those that favor back and side. It has a unique shape and truthfully it is a good value for those that are in the market for a new pillow.

author: Catherine Marks
title: Shoulder pressure is gone, so we ordered two more
body: We love this pillow! Takes ALL the pressure off the shoulders. We ordered 2 more.

author: Bailey Q.
title: My neck and shoulders feel better, even if the dip feels odd
body: Has completely eliminated my shoulder and neck issues as a side sleeper. My head doesn’t fit comfortably in the indentation when on my side so I find myself sleeping on the “wing” and using the cut out when I'm on my back. This pillow has worked very well for me.

author: Blake
title: Finally sleeping well again after shoulder surgery
body: I had shoulder surgery and have not been sleeping well. A friend recommended the people. I've had the best sleep I’ve had in a long time. Well worth the investment!

author: sage
title: My head stays put, and I wake up less often
body: Love this pillow. My head just stays in it all night and it helps me to not move around as much or wake up uncomfortable in the middle of the night. Definitely a better nights sleep. Was very impressed!

author: Taylor Z.
title: My wife liked mine so much she got one too
body: I bought this pillow to try something different. I've tried foam pillows which never stay fluffed and other feather pillows that always hurt my neck. This thing works great for how I sleep! My wife got so jealous we bought her one too!

author: Linda Matthew Beard
title: I toss and turn, but this pillow still supports me
body: I'm a person that flip flops all night. Regardless of the position I'm laying this pillow supports your head, neck and shoulders. With neck problems this pillow is amazing. I get up in the morning and I don't hurt.

author: Mackenzie T.
title: Great support, but finding the right pillowcase is tricky
body: This is the perfect pillow for people who have plenty of neck and back issues. I would certainly recommend this pillow. The only issue is finding a really good pillow case for it. My queen pillow cases fit it fine but I something a little more form fitting. You really don't have to have a pillow case as It has its on case and it's very comfortable.

author: Carrie Mccormick
title: My husband and I are both sleeping better
body: This is the best pillow you will ever have your entire life and the only one you’ll ever need. My husband and I both purchased one and we have had better quality sleep since.

author: Amy White
title: The shape looked odd, but it's so comfortable
body: The design of it may seem slightly odd at first glance but once you lay down and settle, it is the most comfortable pillow ever. I’ve had it about three weeks now and not once have I woken up with a sore neck. Definitely worth the buy! Doesn’t get hot at all and it’s nicely shaped.

author: Kendall
title: I'd give this pillow ten stars if I could
body: This Neck pillow is the last pillow I will ever buy. I have pain in my back,headaches, other pains I had to try this pillow for over a month to give it a review. And I love it if they had 10 stars to give this I would

author: Bailey F.
title: My dad liked mine, so I got him one too
body: I bought this pillow due to neck pain It has helped I bought a second one for my dad after he saw and tried mine and liked it.

author: ROBIN
title: After the adjustment period, I'm sleeping much better
body: Need first few day to get use to. After that I slept much better thorugh out the night. Haven't got any neck discomfort after using this pillow. Perfect fit for me.

author: Mrs. Whitney
title: My first non-standard pillow is actually helping
body: This is my first ever purchase of ani other type of pillow other than the normal standard pillow. I decided to give this a try because I was having back/neck stiffness when I woke up. I love been using this pillow a bit over two months, and it is working well for me. It's something the bosubhas to get used too, but after about 1 week, I found which position worked best for me and I've been relieved from a lot of the morning tightness.

author: Shawn Derek Joann Hoffman
title: Give it a couple of nights, then find your spot
body: It took a couple of nights to get used to! But once you find your spot its life changing! I get up refereshed no neck, back or shoulder pain !

author: Casey
title: Less snoring, less tossing, and a much better night's sleep
body: This product has helped with my sleep tremendously!!! It's helped my snoring, restlessness, and aches and pains. It also has helped with numbness. This pillow alowas for every type of sleepers. Side, back, and stomach!!!

author: Charlie X.
title: One night in, and my neck already feels better
body: I slept so good the first night I used it. Neck doesn’t hurt when I get up in the mornings.

author: Charlie
title: I can finally sleep in different positions without pain
body: I've had neck and shoulder injuries and this pillow offers me the perfect level of comfort and relief when it is time to lay down. I often have trouble finding a good position to sleep in but with this pillow I can lay every way. I love the arm rests on both sides so I can turn facing both ways and still be comfy. The foam has just the right amount of firmness and softness where it is not stiff but I’m also not sinking. This pillow is such a game changer.

author: Reese
title: I sleep better every night, so it's coming everywhere with me
body: I have problems getting comfortable with pillows, until I bought this one! I will take it wherever I go as I sleep better nightly!

author: Dakota
title: Comfortable for a while, but I need more support
body: Not enough support for me, but It's comfortable for short amounts of time.

author: Taylor I.
title: My neck gets the support it needs as a side sleeper
body: I have been sleeping so much better since receiving my new pillow. I'm a side sleeper and it supports my neck and head perfectly!

author: Taylor
title: Finally something that works with my tricky shoulders
body: As someone with hypermobile shoulders, it's a nightmare to fall asleep as many positions end up being painful or even numb my shoulders. This one is really comfortable because it allows support for my neck and shoulders. I usually sleep on my stomach and have my arms hug the pillow, which I can't do with regular pillows, so this has been a lifesaver.

author: Morgan
title: More restful nights with better head and neck support
body: We have tried quite a few different pillows, but this one is amazing. It provides wonderful support for the head and neck. I've been having more quality sleep and extremely restful nights.

author: Jordan Y.
title: Third one and still very happy with it
body: This was my 3rd pillow. Very pleased as always.

author: Parker J.
title: Best purchase I've made for my stiff neck
body: It’s great to wake up and not have a stiff neck and shoulders. I fall asleep, almost instantaneously when I hit the pillow it’s the best purchase I’ve ever made.

author: LUCAS HUFFMAN
title: Just the right firmness without getting too hot
body: I've had pillows similar to this but this one blows them away! I'm a back/side sleeper and this pillow allows me to stay in comfort in all positions without having to reposition my pillow like with others. The temperature is consistent and the pillow is just right in regards to firmness. I have finally found a great answer to my neck pain that would often wake me up and leave me with neck pain in the morning. The "wings" on the bottom fit nicely against my shoulders keeping my head in place throughout the night. In short, this pillow is perfect for me!!!

author: Phillip Nunez
title: My neck pain was gone in just two days
body: This pillow is amazing for neck support. It is very pleasant to use and my neck pain was gone in 2 days. It is vacuum sealed so make sure you let it fluff for an hour or so before using. Highly recommended!!

author: Parker
title: My husband sleeps comfortably after neck surgery
body: My husband has been using this pillow for the past few weeks and he loves it! He has neck disc surgery last summer and this pillow supports his neck so well and he had his first good light sleep using this pillow. When he sleeps on his side or his back he is comfortable. Highly recommend.

author: Quinn
title: Comfortable in every position, and easy to clean
body: This pillow is absolutely comfortable. You can sleep on your stomach, on your back, and even on your side without it irritating your shoulder or neck. If you deal with neck problems, this is an absolute must-have, especially because it's memory foam, so it doesn't go flat. The custom-made case for the pillow is also great, and it's easy to clean.

author: Reese T
title: Arrived quickly, feels great, and may help with snoring
body: Product arrived very quickly. Upon opening, I didn’t notice any unpleasant odor. Pillow is ergonomically designed to support the neck. It's nicely shaped & well made. Very comfortable & possibly helps with snoring relief! Recommend.

author: Sage F.
title: The second one didn't puff up quite like the first
body: This is our second pillow but I feel like it didn’t fluff up as much as our first one. But we will continue to use it.

author: George Reed
title: I was skeptical, but this pillow proved me wrong
body: I love this pillow. It’s been life changing. I’ll be honest, I was skeptical about what this pillow could do that the other 6-7 pillows I’ve bought to alleviate my pain in my neck haven’t. I also went into this having received a recommendation for this shaped pillow from a friend a few months ago, that I dismissed because I’ve already tried so many pillows. But now I’ve tried this one and it’s alleviated my neck pain fully. The pillow offers good neck support when lying on your back, it’s not too high or too low for me but it’s also firm enough that in the 6 weeks I’ve had the pillow, I’ve not noticed any breakdown in support. I can turn my face slightly to the side, and my face is gently cradled by the pillow. If you want to turn fully on your side? Go for it! The pillow works well that way too! I’m not someone who needs/wants to use the contours of the pillow to have my arms raised up near my head, but I've placed my arms there and I think if you normally sleep like that, this pillow would work well. The material of the pillow case is soft and It's got washed well. I did not detect a lingering smell once out of its packaging, so if there was one, it was very faint and dissipated quickly. For its price, it’s 100% worth trying. I can't recommend this pillow enough no already recommended it to my mom, who purchased it and similarly thinks it’s great!

author: Avery
title: No strong smell, and I sleep better with it
body: I've been using this pillow since the day I received it. There was no strong smell as others indicated for me at least. Since using this I've only once tried to use regular pillows (just cuz hubby took it for one night). That was the worst nights sleep I got. Ive noticed I wake up much less throughout the night and without any type of pain from sleeping on my shoulders or hands. Back sleeping is much more comfortable being able the easily rest my head cradled between the memory foam. Which for me also doubles as a sound blocker at night, bonus. I've also noticed others worry about the aesthetic appeal of it which I find to be no issue. Simply place an ordinary pillow on top of it when making the bed and it becomes disguised in the normal feng shui of the bed. That way when u throw all those pillows off your bed at night it's right there waiting to cradle your head into an amazing nights sleep. As for washing it, the zipper on the the back makes it simple to remove so no problems there. Also I wouldn't recommend drying it to avoid shrinkage, although there is no label saying it can not be dryed. Just my personally opinion on the matter. All in all if you are looking at this pillow and thinking of buying, but like me may be apprehensive of the price for one pillow. I can assure It's it worth the buy. Spend the extra money on this pillow I highly doubt you will regret that decision once you've slept on it. As for me, there's no chance I'll go back to regular pillows after sleeping on this thing, they don't even compare. Just try to make sure your kids don't take yours like mine try to do with me.

author: SAGE
title: I can stay on my side or back without shifting around
body: It's been a few months since I got this pillow. I usually start out sleeping on my side and rotate throughout the night. With this pillow I no longer do that. I can comfortably stay on either my side or back. I like that the pillow has different heights on each side so it accommodates varies sleeping styles. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because sometimes my ear gets sore if I lay on my side too long. I haven't had any issues with flatness, shape changes or it being too hot.

author: drew714
title: Finally waking up without that morning pain
body: I don't always wake up with neck or back pain, but when I do, it ruins my morning for several hours. I've tried different pillows and some work a bit, others don't work at all. So I tried this pillow... What a noticeable difference! I've been getting up without pain, and for that, I'm grateful.

author: jamie
title: My neck feels hugged, and I sleep like a baby
body: I have neck issues and this pillow has been amazing! It perfectly hugs my neck and head and I sleep like a baby with no discomfort at all and I get up with no pain. Great purchase and I'd certainly recommend to anyone with neck issues!

author: Robin
title: It felt hard at first, but the support is worth it
body: I've used this pillow for 2 weeks now. I had neck surgery a few years back and I have tried many different pillows since. This pillow has made a noticeable difference. It was a little hard the first 2 days but then the memory foam worked as it should molding the pillow to my head size to provide comfortable support. I'm both, a back and side sleeper. This pillow works for both. I did not notice any bad smell as mentioned by other reviewers. Overall this is a great pillow at an affordable price.

author: Riley
title: My wife is finally sleeping through the night
body: This pillow works great for my wife’s neck situation. She sleeps through the entire night with no problems, wakes up refreshed without any aches/pain. Definitely a buy for anyone with sleep problems.

author: Kristi William Mark Jacobs
title: Easy to wash and comfortable in every position
body: I’ve been in the look for a really good pillow that helps with my neck and back discomfort. This one exceeds by far my expectations! It has helped me feel no pain when I wake up and fits perfectly in any position I used it. Washing It's extremely easy and it looks like new after every wash. Loved it

author: Philip Chavez
title: Great for propping myself up to watch TV
body: I’m pleased with this because of his ergonomic shape and is very useful to keep your head propped in a comfortable position while laying back and watching TV I would certainly recommend

author: Drew U
title: Love the little spaces for my arms
body: Love the size of the pillow and it’s so comfortable. The feature I like the most is the wings on each side (a place for my arms).

author: Quinn L.
title: Would definitely buy this pillow again
body: I’ve tried other support pillows, and wasn’t convinced this was going to work, but it was great! Great support, well-made. If I needed another one, I'd definitely purchase this again.

author: R. Thompson
title: After trying so many pillows, this one really helps
body: Finally, a pillow that’s worth more than what it cost! I’ve spent hundreds and hundreds on pillows, including some purchased at a chiropractor’s office. None of them was as comfortable and helpful to me as this pillow. I love the removable/washable cover on this pillow. Whichever position I used this pillow in, it was comfortable. After a more than eight hours sleep, I woke up with my shoulders at ease and not in severe pain. After having used this pillow for a while now, I can say that it didn’t make me sweat at any time. It’s soft enough that I don’t wake up feeling like my ears are squished beyond repair. That being said, it’s firm enough to provide comfortable, constant and proper support. I absolutely love this pillow and when I finally wear it out, I’m going to be buying another one. This thing is just awesome!

author: Jonathan Morales
title: Good pillow, but not quite right for broad shoulders
body: I will start off by saying that this pillow has a really funky design that can be a bit confusing the first few times you take the cover off to wash it, but you'll quickly figure out the quirks. I’m pleased with this pillow for the most part, however I am a 6' 1" guy with really broad shoulders who side sleeps. This pillow doesn't totally fit me even with a really thin pillow under it. I enjoy it for a reading/relaxing pillow as it does help you relax, but I could never quite get it to fit my neck right when sleeping and woke up, more than once with a crick in my neck that lasted throughout the day.

author: Michael Sims
title: My husband loves it, but I need a satin pillowcase
body: I initially wanted this for me but I've curly hair and can't use it without a satin pillow case. So I took a star off for that. My husband really liked it tho. Supports neck properly and made me fall asleep when I was trying it

author: quinn
title: Finally found the right height and thickness
body: I always had problems finding the right pillow with the right hight ans thickness but this one solved all the problem Usually I sleep 6 hours max today I slept 8 hours Great product.

author: Mackenzie
title: I'm waking up refreshed and pain-free
body: Ever since purchasing this pillow, I've noticed a significant improvement in the quality of my sleep. Not only does it provide excellent support for my neck when I turn to the side, but it also helps me feel more comfortable throughout the night. The design seems to align perfectly with the contours of my head and neck, promoting a more natural and relaxed sleeping position. Waking up feeling refreshed and without any neck pain has become a regular occurrence since I started using this pillow. I'd certainly recommend it to anyone in search of a better night's sleep.

author: Drew
title: My neck is getting better day by day
body: I was having some neck and back pain issues.. after using this pillow its getting better day by day.. It offers a great comfort and support to your neck area..which helps you to not get up with a stiff neck. Happy using it..

author: Ava's Mommy 15
title: Soft but firm, and it keeps its shape
body: It’s firm but it’s also soft. The pillow holds its shape well after using. I use it to help relieve pressure on my lower back and hips when I lay down. This pillow won’t disappoint.

author: M. decker
title: Best pillow I've tried for neck and back pain
body: So I've tried a few pillows from Amazon and this pillow is for sure the best one I have got. It's so comfortable and easy to adjust to your neck and back. The quality of my sleep has improved significantly since I got this pillow. I would totally recommend it if your have necks or backs pains because of sleeping posture.

author: S. Williams
title: Comfy on my back, though side sleeping takes practice
body: I've used this pillow for a few weeks now and wanted to wait before I passed judgemental. As you can see by the pictures, the pillow is the standard size but It's shaped to fit you neck and rest it correctly when lying on your back. I am not a back sleeper, but I sleep on my side with my arm under my pillow regularly. This pillow is designed to have your arm sliding under the curvature where your neck goes; there are ribs at the top of the pillow to put your other hand. There is a dip in the middle of the pillow for your head to rest in either on your side or back, however it works better when I'm on my back rather than my side. It is very comfortable and takes some getting used to if you are a side sleeper, but prefect for back sleepers. It has helped with some of my neck pain I have in the mornings.

author: Sydney
title: No more stacking pillows to get my neck comfortable
body: I have always slept with multiple pillows. I stacked them so that I have proper neck support. This pillow is perfect for that. I don’t have to stack with this pillow because the design allows me to have the support that I need. It’s very comfortable, but it does take getting used to. When you open the pillow because of the way, it’s packaged the direction to tell you to allow it a few days to air out, this is a must. It comes with a detachable pillowcase which was very simple to take off and easy to put back on, so there is no hassle when you need to wash it. This is a great pillow with a great design.

author: Cameron
title: Great support for my neck, back, and side sleeping
body: I really enjoy sleeping on this pillow. I have neck and back pain and was needing a pillow to give me extra support, which I found in this one. I am a big side sleeper and this pillow allows me to put my arm under one of the side supports without the pillow pushing up into my face. It keeps my spine straight and has allowed me to have a more comfortable sleep. There are times I like to lay on my stomach and watch TV, which this pillow is made for! The two side flaps allow you to comfortably rest you head into the pillow and then to have your arms on the sides without bunching up the pillow or messing with your head/neck. Breathing is also a little easier with the way it tilts your neck slightly, making airflow easier. The memory foam is great in this and feels super supportive. All around fan of this pillow!

author: harper111
title: Finally sleeping through the night without a stiff neck
body: This is a really good pillow. It relieves my stressed and damaged neck. I have trouble sleeping all night long because of my neck and this pillow was my life saver. I sleep through the night and wake up without my neck stiff and cracking. The size could not be better. It's the size of a full size pillow and it's thick not thin an flimsy. It doesn't grab your neck but lets your neck settle on it a contour to your neck. I can roll on my side with ease and not be uncomfortable. See my pics you'll see the thickness and size is perfect. I would recommend this pillow to everyone.

author: Michael Bates
title: My neck feels better, and the headaches are easing up
body: Very happy with this pillow, it has helped so much with neck support. Not waking up so often with headaches
